description: This is a test source file for the SettingsDialog component in an Android app, containing UI tests for different states and configurations of the settings dialog.

classes.name: SettingsDialogTest
classes.description: Test class for the SettingsDialog UI component, verifying display and behavior under various states and configurations.

methods.name: whenLoading_showsLoadingText
methods.description: Tests that the loading state displays the loading text.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_allDefaultSettingsAreDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies that all default settings are displayed correctly when the state is success.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_supportsDynamicColor_usesDefaultBrand_DynamicColorOptionIsDisplayed
methods.description: Checks that dynamic color options are displayed when supported and default brand is used.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_notSupportDynamicColor_DynamicColorOptionIsNotDisplayed
methods.description: Ensures dynamic color options are hidden when not supported.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_usesAndroidBrand_DynamicColorOptionIsNotDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies dynamic color options are hidden when Android brand is selected.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_allLinksAreDisplayed
methods.description: Checks that all informational links are visible in the success state.
